verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships a first-party, browser-based visual Editor for drag-and-drop scene building. It supports real-time collaborative editing of the same scene, live tweaking of materials and positions, and a viewport, and an independent comment confirms it comes with "a nice scene editor". Missing for 10: no evidence of a prefab/template system for scene composition, no explicit documentation of the inspector panel, and limited hands-on corroboration of level-building depth.
